{{DISPLAYTITLE:Secrets and Easter Eggs in ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''}}
The following is a list of secrets, easter eggs, and hidden trivia references in {{SA}}.
----

==General==
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"
|-
! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description
|-
|[[File:Secrets-GTASA-MapEditor.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>3ds Max Screenshot</u><br>Inside one of the guard booths (the one that is near the spawn location of [[Leviathan]] and [[Raindance]]) within the [[Easter Bay Airport]], there is a computer running 3ds Max ({{WP|Autodesk}} tool used by [[Rockstar North]] to create the models for the [[RenderWare]]-based titles), showing a screenshot of the interior props found in the [[Las Venturas City Planning Department]].
|-
|[[File:Catalina'sHideout-GTASA-ThreeGraves.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Catalina's Past</u><br>Near [[Catalina]]'s [[Catalina's Hideout|cabin]], there are three graves and a [[shovel]], suggesting she may have murdered and buried past lovers prior to meeting [[Carl Johnson]].
|-
|[[File:Easter_Eggs_-_BRIDGE_FACTS.png|175px|center]][[File:GantBridge-GTASAde-BridgeFacts.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Gant Bridge Facts</u><br>At the [[Gant Bridge Visitor Center|visitor center]] below [[Katie Zhan's House]], there is a list of facts about the [[Gant Bridge]], one of which reads "''Takes up a staggering 1.27mb of disk space.''"<br><br>In {{TDE}}, the sign is updated to reflect the size of the new version of the bridge, reading that it "''Takes up a staggering 38.9mb of disk space''."
|-
|[[File:GantBridge-GTASA-EasterEgg.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Hidden Sign</u><br>On top of the [[Gant Bridge]], there is a sign that reads "''There are no easter eggs up here. Go away.''"
|-
|[[File:MassGrave-GTASA-Bodies.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Mass Grave</u><br>Near [[Area 69 (3D Universe)|Area 69]], there is a [[Mass Grave|hole]] that is filled with six body bags.
|-
|[[File:ScottWilson-GTASA.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Scott Wilson's Grave</u><br>In the [[Palomino Creek]] graveyard, there is a grave which reads "''R.I.P Scott Wilson''", referring to the Rockstar North [[Scott Wilson (Developer)|level designer]] who worked on the countryside areas of the game.
|-
|}

==[[Rockstar Games]] Logo==

! scope="col"|Description

|-
|[[File:Parachute-GTASA.jpg|175px|center]]

==Gaming References==
===Rockstar===
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"
|-
! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description
|-
|[[File:CarcerGas-GTASA-PropaneTank.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Carcer Gas</u><br>[[Carcer Gas]] cylinders are from [[Carcer City (3D Universe)|Carcer City]], the setting of ''[[Manhunt]]''.
|-
|[[File:BigSmokesCrackPalace-GTASA-Doormat.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Doormat</u><br>Inside [[Big Smoke's Crack Palace]], there is a doormat that reads "''Not Welcome Rockstar North''" with the Rockstar North logo in the center.
|-
|[[File:Hydra-GTASA-DMA.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Hydra</u><br>Part of the text on the side of the [[Hydra]] features the letters "DMA"; this is likely a reference to Rockstar North since the company was formerly known as DMA Design. DMA is also a play on {{WP|United States Marine Corps}} squadrons that use the {{WP|McDonnell Douglas AV-8B Harrier II|AV-8B Harrier II}} (VMA).
|-
|[[File:LasVenturasCityPlanningDepartment-GTASA-Blueprint2.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Manhunt Blueprint</u><br>On the top floor of the Las Venturas City Planning Department, the blueprints of {{Manhunt|Starkweather's Estate}} from ''Manhunt'' can be seen on the wall.
|-
|[[File:LasVenturasPoliceStation-GTASA-Interior25.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Mugshots</u><br>Inside [[Las Venturas Police Headquarters]], there are pictures of [[James Earl Cash]] and members of {{Manhunt|The Hoods}} from Rockstar North's ''[[Manhunt]]''.
|-
|[[File:NorthstarRock-GTASA.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Northstar Rock</u><br>[[Northstar Rock]] is a reference to Rockstar North.
|-
|
|<u>State of Emergency</u><br>The [[Cheats in GTA San Andreas|cheat code]] "Chaos Mode" could reference Rockstar and {{WP|VIS Entertainment}}'s 2001 game, ''{{WP|State of Emergency (video game)|State of Emergency}}''. Chaos Mode was one of the playable game modes in this game.
|-
|[[File:TankerCommander-GTASA-SS2.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Window Pane</u><br>The [[Gasso]] gas station in [[Dillimore]] has a sign on its window reading "''Max Pane- Bulletproof Glass"''. This is a reference to {{WP|Remedy Entertainment|Remedy}}'s ''[[Max Payne]]'' franchise, published by Rockstar Games.
|-
|[[File:JamesEarlCashActionFigure-GTASA-ZeroRC.jpg|175px|center]][[File:PiggsyActionFigure-GTASA-ZeroRC.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Zero RC</u><br>Inside Zero RC, there are figures of not just {{VC}} characters, but also characters from Rockstar's 2003 game, ''Manhunt''. The characters for it include James Earl Cash and {{Manhunt|Piggsy}}.
|-
|}

===Previous ''GTA'' Games===
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"
|-
! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description
|-
|[[File:Wardrobe-GTASA-Interior.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Carl's surfboard</u><br>Carl's [[wardrobe]] contains a surfboard with an image of [[Vice City (3D Universe)|Vice City]] on it.
|-
|[[File:DeniseRobinsonHouse-GTASA-Interior2.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Denise's poster</u><br>In [[Denise Robinson]]'s [[Denise Robinson's House|house]], there is a poster of ''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City's'' box art on her bedroom wall.
|-
|[[File:Dwaine&Jethro-GTAVC.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Jethro & Dwaine</u><br>In the mission [[Wear Flowers in Your Hair]], [[The Truth]] says that his guys ([[Jethro]] and [[Dwaine]]) "''used to work on marine engines, 'til the mob bought their business over in Vice.''" This may refer to [[Tommy Vercetti]] and his [[Vercetti Gang|gang]] taking over the [[Viceport Boatyard|shipyard]] in the events of ''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City''.
|-
|[[File:Ryder'sHouse-GTASA-LivingRoom.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Ryder's poster</u><br>In [[Ryder]]'s [[Ryder's House|house]], there is a ''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City'' poster near the TV.
|-
|[[File:SexShopXXX-GTASA-ViceCity.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>Films inside the sex shop</u><br>Inside the enterable branch of [[Sex Shop XXX]] in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]], on the counter in the back, there are multiple stacks of films called "''Grand Theft Auto: Vice City''", clearly referencing the previous game in the series.
|-
|[[File:V-RockHotel-GTASA-exterior.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>V-Rock hotel</u><br>The [[V-Rock Hotel]] in [[Las Venturas (3D Universe)|Las Venturas]] is a reference to the [[V-Rock (3D Universe)|V-Rock]] radio station in ''GTA Vice City''.
|-
|[[File:ViceCity-GTAVC-BetaMapGTASA.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Vice City map</u><br>Across the street from the [[Angel Pine]] [[Cluckin' Bell (3D Universe)|Cluckin' Bell]], in several trash cans, there is an early map of [[Vice City (3D Universe)|Vice City]]. This is a double meaning Easter egg - scrapped maps literally scrapped in-game.
|-
|}

===Other Games===
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"
|-
! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description
|-
|[[File:MaddDogg'sRhymes-GTASA-DRIV3RReference.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''Driver''</u><br>During the mission [[Madd Dogg's Rhymes]], a guard remarks: "''Man, how could Refractions mess up so bad? Tanner, you suck!''" while he is playing a video game. This is a reference to {{WC|Driver|John Tanner|Tanner}}, the protagonist of the ''{{WP|Driver (series)|Driver}}'' video game series, developed by {{WP|Ubisoft Reflections|Reflections}}.
|-
|[[File:Crowbar-GTASA-Area69.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''Half-Life''</u><br>In the mission [[Black Project]], the player can spot a [[crowbar]] on a table in a lab. This is a reference to Valve's [[1998]] game ''{{WP|Half-Life (video game)|Half-Life}}''.
|-
|[[File:EasterEgg-GTASAde-RIPOpposition.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Opposition Memorial</u><br>The [[Opposition Memorial]] in [[Hashbury]], [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]], all of the tombstones read "RIP Opposition 1997-2004". This is a reference to rivals of the {{S}}, which came out with its first game in [[1997]]. The phrase "RIP Opposition" is referencing Rockstar's rivalry with other game companies, and how all of Rockstar's opposition has not been able to come out with a better video game. The opposition may also refer to the game ''Driver 3'', which was a long-time rival of Rockstar and that came out in the same year as ''GTA San Andreas'' and got negative votes from critics.
|-
|[[File:BlackProject-GTASA-SS52.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Postal''</u><br>In the mission Black Project, after the player enters the base and the alarm is raised, one of the voice announcements says "''Personnel reminded that running in corridors whilst holding scissors is not permitted''". This is a possible reference to the video game company {{WP|Running with Scissors}}, best known for its ''{{WP|Postal (video game)|Postal}}'' games, which are considered by some to be "''GTA'' Clones".
|-
|[[File:Zombotech1 A.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Resident Evil''</u><br>The [[Zombotech Corporation]] is most likely a reference to the Umbrella Corporation from the ''{{WP|Resident Evil (series)|Resident Evil}}'' series. Also, based on a diagram on the wall, there appears to be a large underground facility reminiscent of {{WC|residentevil|The Hive (Anderson)|The Hive}} from the ''Resident Evil'' film.
|-
|[[File:TrueGrimeStreetCleaners-GTASA-Logo.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''True Crime''</u><br>There are multiple billboards around the state referencing a company named [[True Grime Street Cleaners]]. This is a reference to the ''{{WP|True Crime (series)|True Crime}}'' series, another open world game with similar gameplay to that of the ''GTA'' series.
|-
|}

==Media References==
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"
|-
! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description
|-
|[[File:SupplyLines-GTASA-Mission.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Apocalypse Now''</u><br>[[Zero]]'s quote from the mission [[Supply Lines...]], "''The smell, you know that ozone smell, smells like...victory!''" is a reference to the movie ''{{WP|Apocalypse Now}}'', specifically to Lieutenant Colonel William "Bill" Kilgore's well-known quote "''The smell, you know that gasoline smell, the whole hill. Smelled like... victory.''"{{Ref|name=apocalypse|type=youtube|url={{YT|bPXVGQnJm0w|Apocalypse Now - smell of napalm}}}}.
|-
|[[File:TripSkip-GTASA-Icon.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Back to the Future''</u><br>The [[Trip Skip]] icon features the side profile of the [[Deluxo]], a car mostly inspired by the {{WP|DeLorean DMC-12}} that is otherwise absent from the game. This is a reference to the ''{{WP|Back to the Future}}'' franchise, which features a DeLorean-based time machine.
|-
|[[File:ImageNeeded.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''James Bond''</u><br>The finance company named J. Bond Bail Bonds is a reference to ''{{WP|James Bond}}''.
|-
|[[File:LearningToFly-GTASA-SS13.png|175px|center]]
|<u>"Learning to Fly"</u><br>The mission [[Learning to Fly]] is named after {{WP|Learning to Fly (Pink Floyd song)|the Pink Floyd song of the same name}}.
|-
|[[File:TheIntroduction-GTASA-SS21-DriveBy.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''Menace II Society''</u><br>"[[The Green Sabre]]" is a possible reference to the green 1968 {{WP|Pontiac Executive}} used in the final drive-by scene in the film ''{{WP|Menace II Society}}''. Both vehicles were used in [[Drive-By Shooting|drive-by shootings]] that resulted in the deaths of innocent bystanders, were similar styles of 60s era muscle cars, and were green.
|-
|[[File:ImageNeeded.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Pedestrians</u><br>There is a female [[Pedestrians|pedestrian]] in the game that resembles the character {{WP|Catherine Tramell}} from ''{{WP|Basic Instinct}}'', as well as a male pedestrian who resembles Bishop from ''{{WP|Juice (film)|Juice}}''.
|-
|[[File:CommerceMovies.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''Reservoir Dogs''</u><br>Advertisements for the movie ''[[Reservoir Dregs]]'' can be seen at the movie theater in [[Commerce]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]]. This is a spoof of the real-life movie ''{{WP|Reservoir Dogs}}'', directed by {{WP|Quentin Tarantino}}, which was released in 1992.
|-
|[[File:AirRaid-GTASA-Mission.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Star Wars''</u><br>At the end of the mission [[Air Raid]], Zero says "''Great kid, don't get cocky''" which is a reference to {{WP|Han Solo}}'s line from ''{{WP|Star Wars (film)|Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope}}''.
|-
|[[File:JustBusiness-GTASA-SS62.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''Terminator''</u><br>The scene in the mission [[Just Business]] featuring a [[Packer]] jumping off a surface road in slow motion into a [[Los Santos Storm Drain (3D Universe)|storm drain channel]], which [[Big Smoke]] and CJ are using to escape, is a nod to a similar scene in the [[1991]] film ''{{WP|Terminator 2: Judgment Day}}'', where a large tow-truck executes a similar stunt as it is in pursuit of John Connor.
|-
|[[File:ImageNeeded.png|175px|center]]
|<u>''The Big Lebowski''</u><br>When [[Cesar Vialpando|Cesar]] asks CJ if he'd like to make some [[money]], CJ responds "''Does the pope shit in the woods?''", a malapropism coined by The Dude in ''{{WP|The Big Lebowski}}''.
|-
|[[File:CobraMaritalArtsGym-GTASA-exterior.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''The Karate Kid''</u><br>The [[Cobra Marital Arts]] [[Gyms|gym]] is probably a reference to the Cobra Martial Arts gym in the movie ''{{WP|The Karate Kid}}''.
|-
|[[File:TheWizardofAss-GTASA.jpg|175px|center]]
|<u>''The Wizard of Oz''</u><br>An advertisement for the movie ''[[The Wizard of Ass]]'' can be seen at the [[Queens Theater]]. The title of the movie is a spoof of ''{{WP|The Wizard Of Oz}}''.
|-
|}

==Real World References==
{| class="article-table sortable" style="width: 99%; margin: auto;"

! scope="col"|Image
! scope="col"|Description

|[[File:BlackfieldChapel-GTASA-Northwards.jpg|175px|center]]

|-
|[[File:GantBridge-GTASA.jpg|175px|center]][[File:KincaidBridge-GTASA.jpg|175px|center]]

|-
|[[File:ElvisImpersonators-GTASA-CJStealthKill.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Elvis Presley</u><br>Several [[Elvis Impersonators|pedestrians]] resembling {{WP|Elvis Presley}} can be found in Las Venturas.
|-
|[[File:JuguetesRegalos-GTASA-Logo.png|175px|center]]
|<u>Juguetes Regalos</u><br>The signage of the store [[Juguetes Regalos]] features various characters from both ''{{WP|Pokémon}}'' and the {{WP|Disney}} universe.
|-
|}
